# Feature: SLC-4: Domscribe-Adapter

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-23 — from issue #4 + .qa/design/slc-4.md -->

## Intent

Domscribe-Adapter (PRD §19 SLC-4): ausgewählte UI-Elemente lösen über unterstützte Domscribe-Interfaces deterministisch zu Source auf (file, line, column, component + runtime — FR-011). Domscribe ist optional: fehlt/unavailable/unsupported/unresolved → degraded mode mit DOM/Selector-Kontext und sichtbarem Hinweis „Quellzuordnung nicht verfügbar", nie Produkt-Failure (FR-012, FR-029).

## Preconditions

- SLC-1..3 on branch: `SourceContext` in core, bridge selection path, chip `formatChipLabel`, agent tools
- Fixture or injectable `DomscribeLookup` available for unit tests (no live relay required)
- OpenClaw host ≥2026.9.4 for plugin validate

## Happy Path

- [ ] Given Domscribe fixture entry for `data-ds`, when selection.create resolves, then `SourceContext` has exact file/line/component and chip label is `Component · file:line` (T-024 / SCN-009)
- [ ] Given relay/lookup unavailable, when selection.create runs, then selection attaches with degraded `SourceContext`, UI status „Quellzuordnung nicht verfügbar", no failure (T-013 / SCN-008 / INV-5 product continuity)
- [ ] Given stale manifest / fileHash mismatch, when resolve runs, then `freshness: "stale"` advisory and selection remains usable (T-012 / EDGE-006 / BR-007)
- [ ] Adapter-Boundary: `domscribe-adapter` imports only core (no OpenClaw / Chrome); no Domscribe compiler in extension (INV-5/6, Invariant 8)
- [ ] Status evaluated per page/project key, not as global connection failure (FR-029 / SCN-020)
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict)

## Edge Cases

- [ ] EDGE-007: lookup throws/timeouts → typed degraded, selection kept
- [ ] Unmapped `data-ds` → `freshness: "unmapped"`, not throw
- [ ] No `data-ds` → selector-only chip; product still works
- [ ] `domscribeEnabled: false` → always degraded unavailable

## Regression

- [ ] SLC-1..3 tests remain green (chips no-send, pairing, prepare/admit tools)
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test` + plugin validate green

## Assumptions

- Q-002: HTTP relay via public `GET /api/manifest/:id` + `/api/health`; fixture/memory lookup for tests; configurable `domscribeRelayUrl` (dynamic relay port)
- German UI strings for source-mapping status (locale: de)

## Security Coverage

- INV-5 / INV-6: adapter boundary — no OpenClaw in core/protocol; adapter → core only
- BR-007: stale mapping advisory only; selector context retained
- BR-010: runtimeSummary bounded/redacted via existing `admitSelection`
- NFR-006: runtime ≤64 KiB enforced in core
- INV-1: resolve on selection never sends / starts agent run
- INV-3: unchanged session binding on bridge attach
- F-03/B-01/B-04: no new public auth surface beyond existing plugin bridge; relay is localhost optional dep
